newsitem.title: FRANCE: Roussel Uclaf 1996 net income rises.
newsitem.headline: Roussel Uclaf 1996 net income rises.

text.p: (Figures in millions of French francs unless stated)
Net income on a comparable basis

Note - Roussel Uclaf gave its results in a statement. It said group sales rose 3.8 percent over the prior year and rose 2.8 percent on a comparable basis, restating 1995 figures to reflect the full scope of consolidation at December 31, 1996.

The 1996 income figure includes net restructuring charges of around 420 million francs. The net impact of capital gains on disposals, including the sale of Laboratories Lutsia, exceeded 1.1 billion francs.
Net income rose 10.6 percent, in line with the group's forecast.

Healthcare sales increased 6.8, or 2.4 percent on a like-for-like basis, to 13,483 million francs. Fine chemicals sales fell 5.4 percent to 1,869 million due to problems in the fourth quarter in the United States at the Biochimica Opos subsidiary. Animal health sales totalled 521 million.
